info.title: AutoCanvas API
info.description: HTTP API of the AutoCanvas server. Conventions: https://bexy315.github.io/autocanvas/technical/api

get.description: Product name and version. Needs no authentication, so clients can check that they talk to an AutoCanvas server.

post.description: Checks user name and password and sets the session cookie. Every failure gives the same answer. Too many failures for a name lock it for 15 minutes; too many attempts from one address are refused with 429.
Ends the current session and removes the cookie.
Ends every session of the signed-in user, on all devices.

get.description: The account with its groups. Also works while the password must be changed, so clients can show that.

put.description: Needs the current password and a session (not an API token). Ends every other session of the user.

get.description: Where the user is signed in, newest first; the current session is marked.
Newest first, without the secrets. Needs a session: a token cannot manage tokens.

post.description: The answer contains the secret once; store it right away. Send it as 'Authorization: Bearer acp_…'. Needs a session.

delete.summary: Delete one of my API tokens
delete.description: Requests with the token fail from now on. Needs a session.

get.description: Ordered by user name, one page at a time (see API conventions: paging).

post.description: The user must change the given password at the first sign-in.

patch.description: Display name, e-mail, admin and disabled. The last enabled admin cannot be demoted or disabled (409).

delete.description: Removes the account with its sessions, tokens and memberships; the audit log keeps the name. Not the last enabled admin (409).

post.description: The user must change it at the next sign-in; their sessions end.

delete.description: For example when a token has leaked. Requests with it fail from now on.

get.description: Ordered by name with member counts, one page at a time (see API conventions: paging).

get.summary: Get a group with its members

delete.description: Removes the group and its memberships; the users stay.

put.summary: Add a user to a group
put.description: Adding a member twice changes nothing.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a group

get.description: The topmost folders the caller may view, each with the names of the folders above it. For admins: the top-level folders.

post.description: At the top level anyone may create a folder and becomes its Owner; a subfolder needs Editor on the parent and inherits from it.

get.description: With the caller's role and the folders above it. The ETag header is the folder's version, for If-Match.

patch.description: Needs Editor. Send If-Match with the ETag to avoid overwriting someone else's change (412).

delete.description: Needs Owner, and the folder must be empty (409 otherwise). Its grants go with it.

get.description: Ordered by name, one page at a time. Restricted subfolders appear only to callers with a role on them.

post.description: With everything below it. Needs Editor on the folder and on the new parent, or Owner to move it to the top level. Rights change with the place.

put.summary: Restrict a folder or lift that
put.description: Needs Owner. In a restricted folder, grants from above no longer apply; the caller keeps access through an explicit Owner grant.

get.summary: List the grants on a folder
get.description: Roles given directly on this folder, users first. Needs Owner.

put.summary: Grant a role on a folder
put.description: To a user or a group; replaces the role they had on this folder. Needs Owner.

delete.description: Needs Owner. Removing your own Owner grant can lock you out; an admin can repair that.

newPassword.description: The new password: 12 to 256 characters, not the user name.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: A new password for the signed-in user.

token.description: The secret to send as `Authorization: Bearer …`.

details.description: The token as it will be listed.

CreatedToken.description: A new API token. string CreatedToken.Token is shown this once and cannot be retrieved again.

name.description: The name: 1 to 100 characters, no slash; unique among its siblings regardless of case.

parentId.description: The folder to create it in (needs Editor there); omitted or null for the top level, where the creator becomes Owner.

name.description: The group name; unique regardless of case.
What the token is for, e.g. the script or machine using it.

expiresAt.description: When the token stops working; never if omitted.

CreateTokenRequest.description: An API token to create for the signed-in user.

userName.description: The name to sign in with: letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; unique regardless of case.

displayName.description: The name shown to other people; defaults to the user name.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user administers the instance.

CreateUserRequest.description: A user to create. The user must change the password at the first sign-in.

id.description: The folder's id, or `null` when the caller may not open it.

FolderCrumb.description: A folder above the current one, for orientation.

FolderRole.description:
Roles on a folder (ADR-0012), each including the ones before it. The numeric order is the
order of power; the database stores the names.

isRestricted.description: Whether grants from above stop applying here.

myRole.description: The caller's role on this folder.

FolderSummary.description: A subfolder as listed under its parent.

parentId.description: The folder above; `null` at the top level.

isRestricted.description: Whether grants from above stop applying here.

path.description: The folders above, from the top level down (names; ids only where the caller may open them).

myRole.description: The caller's role on this folder.

version.description: Changes with every change of the folder; the ETag of the API.

FolderView.description: A folder as the caller sees it.

subjectName.description: The user name or group name.

createdAt.description: When the grant was first made.

GrantView.description: A role granted directly on a folder.

GroupDetails.description: A group with its members, ordered by user name.

GroupSummary.description: A group as shown in a user's memberships.

memberCount.description: How many users are in it.

groups.description: The groups the user is in, ordered by name.

MeView.description: The signed-in user's own account with their groups.

parentId.description: The new parent (needs Editor there), or null for the top level (needs Owner of the folder).

items.description: The items of this page, in list order.

next.description: Cursor of the next page; `null` on the last page.

items.description: The items of this page, in list order.

next.description: Cursor of the next page; `null` on the last page.

items.description: The items of this page, in list order.

next.description: Cursor of the next page; `null` on the last page.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: A password chosen for a user by an admin; the user must change it at the next sign-in.

version.description: The server's version, including the source revision when built from git.

lastSeenAt.description: The last request with this session (to the minute).

expiresAt.description: When the session ends at the latest.

isCurrent.description: Whether this is the session making the request.

SessionView.description: One of the user's sessions, so they can recognize and end the ones they do not know.

userId.description: The user; give either this or groupId.

groupId.description: The group; give either this or userId.

SetGrantRequest.description: A role for one user or one group on a folder; replaces the role they had there.

isRestricted.description: True to stop inheritance at this folder; false to lift that.

SetRestrictionRequest.description: Whether grants from above apply to a folder.

userName.description: The user name; case does not matter.

me.description: The signed-in user with their groups.

expiresAt.description: When the session ends at the latest.

SignInResponse.description: A successful sign-in. The session itself travels in an HttpOnly cookie, never in the body.

name.description: What the token is used for.

hint.description: The start and last characters, to recognize the token.

expiresAt.description: When the token stops working; never if empty.

lastUsedAt.description: The last request made with it (to the minute).

isExpired.description: Whether the token no longer works because it expired.

TokenView.description: An API token as listed: everything except the secret, which is shown only once.

description.description: A new description; an empty string removes it.

UpdateFolderRequest.description: Changes to a folder; omitted properties stay as they are.

description.description: A new description; an empty string removes it.

UpdateGroupRequest.description: Changes to a group; omitted properties stay as they are.

email.description: A new contact address; an empty string removes it.

isAdmin.description: Grant or take away instance administration.

isDisabled.description: Block or unblock the user; blocking signs them out everywhere.

UpdateUserRequest.description: Changes to a user; omitted properties stay as they are.

userName.description: The name used to sign in.

displayName.description: The name shown to other people.

UserSummary.description: A user as shown in member lists.

userName.description: The name used to sign in.

displayName.description: The name shown to other people.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user administers the instance.

isDisabled.description: Whether the user is blocked from signing in.

mustChangePassword.description: Whether the user has to replace a password someone else set.

lastSignInAt.description: The last successful sign-in, if any.

UserView.description: A user as administrators and the user themselves see it; never the password hash.
